title: Delete a playable asset
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete a playable asset. Only saved playable assets can be deleted. You can use [/playable/save/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/save-a-playable-creative/v1.3) to save a playable asset. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/playable/delete/|/v1.3/playable/delete/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number
`playable_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string
`playable_id`: string| |Response parameter data type|`playable_id`: number|`playable_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/playable/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | Access-Token {Required} | string | Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | playable_id {Required} | string | Playable asset ID. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/playable/delete/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "playable_id": "{{playable_id}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | request_id | string |The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| playable_id | string | Playable asset ID. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "playable_id": "{{playable_id}}" } } (/code); ```
